title: Wales's top scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for Wales in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the end of the 2026 World Cup. Only goals from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.David Brooks: David Brooks is joint 11th with 7, just outside.
notes.Brennan Johnson: Brennan Johnson is joint 11th with 7, just outside.
notes.Ryan Giggs: Ryan Giggs scored 6 of his 12 from 2000.
notes.Craig Bellamy: Craig Bellamy scored 19 for Wales, 2 of them before 2000.
notes.John Hartson: John Hartson scored 14 for Wales, 2 of them before 2000.
notes.Ian Rush: Ian Rush's goals all came before 2000.
notes.Dean Saunders: Dean Saunders scored all but none of his 22 before 2000.

sources: https://www.transfermarkt.com/ceapi/performance-game/<player id> (every match a player played, filtered to the national team and the date window)
checks: Counted match by match from Transfermarkt's per-game data, 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026. Players who began after 2000 checked against Wikipedia's list of Wales internationals (June 2026) and RSSSF; the two who began earlier against the by-year tables in their Wikipedia articles (Bellamy 17 of 19 from 2000, Hartson 12 of 14). All agree except Bale (41 FAW and Wikipedia, 40 Transfermarkt; 41 used). Daniel James had 10 at the cut-off (he scored again in October 2026).
